???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is one basic operation a processor can carry out, such as adding two numbers, called?"

        An instruction. Machine code is a sequence of instructions in numeric form.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "What are the small, very fast storage slots inside the processor called?"

        Registers. Instructions mostly work on values held in them.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "What do we call instructions in the numeric form a processor can execute directly?"

        Machine code. A file of it that the operating system can start is an executable.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: Overview](../compiler/guide/index.md).
